Ask for a copy of the policy. --- ### Quick start guide | Step | Action | Resources | |---|---|---| | 1 | Identify your needs (e.g., 24/7 patrol, event security, corporate office) | Write a brief scope | | 2 | Narrow down to 3–5 providers | Use the table above | | 3 | Call each provider, ask the same set of questions (licensing, insurance, staff training) | Phone numbers listed | | 4 | Request proposals & compare | Spreadsheet | | 5 | Check references & verify credentials | Contact references, DOS license lookup | | 6 | Sign contract & schedule first patrol | Legal review | --- ### Quick links - **New York State Department of State – Licensing**: [https://www.dos.ny.gov/licensing/](https://www.dos.ny.gov/licensing/) - **Google Maps – “Security Guard Agency New York”**: [https://goo.gl/maps](https://goo.gl/maps) - **Yelp – “Security Guard New York”**: [https://www.yelp.com](https://www.yelp.com) Feel free to let me know if you’d like a deeper dive into any of these companies, or if you need help drafting a request‑for‑proposal template!
